newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares tumble under price correction.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares tumble under price correction.

text.p: Zimbabwe's main share index tumbled 97.95 points in active trade on Tuesday, succumbing to a price-correction wave which some analysts expect to remain for the rest of the week.

The 57-counter industrial index closed Monday at 6,894.20 following losses in key shares, including bluechip conglomerate Delta, banking groups Barclays and Finhold, which traded 100 cents down at 3,100, 40 cents lower at 1,950 and minus 50 cents at 1,000 respectively.
"There is some price-correction pressure on the market and I think quite a number shares will come under its test in coming days," one analyst said.
"But we may end the week with a fairly mixed market if we get more bargain hunters into game, and that's looking possible," he added.

Investors have flooded the Zimbabwe share market in the past six weeks, trading on falling interest rates on the local money market and expectations annual inflation -- which fell to a three-year-low of 17.7 percent in August -- will continue to slide.
But brokers say some investors are now wary some shares are getting over-valued.
The secondary seven-counter mining index slipped 0.88 points to 1,374.82 after a 25 cents loss in nickel producer Bindura which traded at 1,125.
